description_html:
Description

Replaces all default trader pictures (including Lightkeeper and BTR driver), supports most updated traders.

For mod to work: run ‘Rename-Cached_Images.bat’ in mod folder and enter 1 to update trader pictures. Refer to installation section for instructions.

Need a new cpu to actually play tarkov so any help towards that goal would be very appreciated

Installation/Uninstall

**Installation:

0. Make sure tarkov and tarkov server are closed before installation.

1. Unzip ‘user’ folder into your SPT directory

2. Go to \user\mods\New furry trader pictures by SashaSwan

3. Run ‘Rename-Cached_Images.bat’ and enter 1. After a few seconds it’s done, you can close the script and play the game.

If pictures won’t show up in game:

Make sure you don’t have any other picture replacers installed.

1. Clear cache in battlestate games launcher settings

2. Run ‘Rename-Cached_Images.bat’ and enter 2 to restore trader pictures. Now enter 1 to update pictures.

Now it should work when you start your Tarkov server again

To uninstall:

1. Run ‘Rename-Cached_Images.bat’ and enter 2. Now you can delete the mod folder.

Update mod

Delete old mod: user\mods\New furry trader pictures by SashaSwan.

Extract new mod to SPT directory.

In ‘user\mods\New furry trader pictures by SashaSwan’
run ‘Rename-Cached_Images.bat’ and enter 2 to restore trader pictures. Now enter 1 to update pictures (restart tarkov server).

How to add your picture

To replace any of my pictures with your own follow these steps:

1. Find jpg (must be jpg) image, preferably 1024x1024 pixels.
2. Go to \New furry trader pictures by SashaSwan\res

3. Replace your picture with the trader you want to change. You should rename it as original image, otherwise it won’t work.

4. Run ‘Rename-Cached_Images.bat’ and enter 2 to restore trader pictures. Now enter 1 to update pictures. Don’t forget to restart the server.
